resources.string: Transparent app icons for Projectivy on Android TV.
%1$s · %2$s. Assign it from the launcher icon picker if it did not auto-apply.
Tap an icon to assign it to the app.
Assigning the 16:9 banner. Switch to Square for the 1:1 glyph.
Assigning the 1:1 glyph. Switch to Banner for the 16:9 card.
Could not deliver %1$s to the launcher.
Opens Projectivy. Set it under Appearance → Cards → Icon Pack. Nothing is changed for you.
Projectivy opened. Go to Appearance → Cards → Icon Pack → Core Builds.
Projectivy Launcher is not installed (com.spocky.projengmenu). Install it, then apply the pack from its settings.
Sets Core Builds as the icon pack in %1$s. Reversible — pick another pack any time.
%1$s is your Home launcher. Other installed launchers are listed below.
Install Projectivy Launcher, then reopen this app to apply in one press.
Sent to %1$s. If the icons don\'t change, restart the launcher.
%1$s didn\'t accept direct apply. Set it here: %2$s
Pulls the APK from GitHub, then the system installer takes over. Nothing installs itself.
APK saved. Press to open the system installer.
Allow installs from this app, then press Install again.
Could not open install permission. Enable unknown sources for Core Builds, then retry.
Select a wallpaper to preview it full-screen, then press Set.
Sets the system home wallpaper. Monet re-themes its tiles from it.
Saves to Pictures and opens the system setter (Fire TV fallback).
Saved to Pictures. Confirm in the system setter.
Saved to Pictures/CoreBuilds. Set it from Monet → Wallpaper.
Wallpaper permission is required to set it.
